name: Schmitty's Chicken Shack
source:
It's your third day working at Schmitty's Chicken Shack, a fast food place in the middle of nowhere. When the store closes on Halloween night, you discover that your boss has been murdered! Can you piece together which of your coworkers did it and bring them to justice?

[From [url=https://punkypilgrim.itch.io/schmittys-chicken-shack]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是你在Schmitty's Chicken Shack工作的第三天，这是一家偏僻的快餐店。当商店在万圣节之夜关门时，你发现你的老板被谋杀了！你能拼凑出是哪位同事干的，并将他们绳之以法吗？

[来自[url=https://punkypilgrim.itch.io/schmittys-chicken-shack]itch.io[/url]]
